library.en: Our school library has over ten thousand books.
library.cn: 我们学校图书馆有一万多本书。

borrow.en: Students may borrow up to four books at a time.

return.en: Don't forget to return the book within two weeks.

quiet.en: We must stay quiet so others can read.
quiet.cn: 我们要保持安静，让别人能看书。

shelf.en: Story books are on the top shelf by the window.
shelf.cn: 故事书在窗边最顶层书架上。

magazine.en: There is a science magazine for children every month.
magazine.cn: 每月都有一本儿童科学杂志。

card.en: Bring your library card with you every time.

page.en: I read about twenty pages of the storybook each night.
page.cn: 我每晚读故事书大约二十页。
